resources.string: Up to date: nothing newer on GitHub
GitHub\'s answer was garbled: try again
Not a newer Brume, deleted: try again
Android didn\'t install it: try again
Android asks you to confirm before it installs
On Android\'s page, turn on Allow from this source, then come back
Brume looks for a newer version on GitHub when it opens. Nothing else leaves the phone.

Everything stays on this phone. Brume has no account and no cloud backup; it goes online only to look for its own updates on GitHub, and sends nothing about you. Data leaves only in a file you save yourself, or in the folder you choose to sync with.

Choose a folder, in Google Drive or on this phone. Brume keeps one file there, brume-sync.json, and updates it after every change. Another phone that chooses the same folder keeps the same journal. The storage app does the uploading: Brume itself goes online only to look for its own updates.
